caption: Every label lands in a ranked list — least restrictive at the top, most restrictive at the bottom — and an admin can reorder it or assign a priority number directly.

eyebrow: Conflicts resolve the same way every time

steps.label: MULTIPLE MATCHES HAPPEN
steps.sub: content can satisfy more than one label's conditions

steps.label: HIGHEST PRIORITY WINS
steps.sub: the highest-numbered label in the list is applied

caption: Labels reach users through label policies, and policies carry their own priority order — a Standard policy for everyone, narrower policies layered on top for specific departments.
An auto-labeling policy is edited and run in simulation mode first — so an admin can see what it would catch before it recommends or applies a label on its own.
Auto-labeling is triggered by sensitive information types — the same catalog used for data loss prevention, including passport numbers, national ID numbers, and payment card data.
